tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures point to coupled memory dynamics, and the archive specifies a four-parameter ODE whose confirmation requires at least eight observations. Five rows cannot identify it reliably, so acquire the fine trajectory batch rather than fitting prematurely.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter coupled memory ODE from the five current rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The verified mechanism requires at least eight rows; five leaves parameters underidentified, especially with mem_conv missing and requiring reconstruction from raw_prefix.
The observed endpoint-matched history gap and coupled transient lag support a history-dependent ODE, not an open-branch static law; s_grad is fixed at zero.
It is irrelevant to resolving the identified ODE parameter ambiguity and is explicitly not worth acquiring.

considered_alternatives.option: Static contrast or uncoupled relaxation model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These omit the observed coupled transient/history dependence and are less consistent with the pilot signatures.
